description: MIND Mind Map — visual mind-mapping canvases at m-i-n-d.ai/#/mind-map. Actions: list, get, create, update, delete, get_shared (read a publicly shared map, no auth needed). Sharing, collaborators and AI generation from a prompt or project stay in the web app at m-i-n-d.ai/#/mind-map.

data.description: Map contents: {nodes, edges, camera, defaults, nextId, notes} — create/update.

map_id.description: Mind map id — required for get/update/delete.

name.description: Map name/title — create/update (defaults to 'Untitled map' on create).

share_id.description: Public share id — required for get_shared.

name: mind_mindmap
